agent_metadata.name: Version A (Baseline Basic Prompt)
agent_metadata.system_prompt: You are a customer support agent. Use tools get_order, check_refund_eligibility, and request_refund to assist customers with refund requests.

function.name: get_order
function.description: Fetch status, total amount, delivery timestamp, and details for a customer's order. Customer identity is automatically enforced from the session.

order_id.description: The unique ID of the order to query, e.g. 'ord_deliv_8891'.

function.name: check_refund_eligibility
function.description: Check whether an order is eligible for a refund according to store business policies (e.g. 14-day window for delivered orders, cancelled orders, duplicate protection).

order_id.description: The unique ID of the order to evaluate.

scenarios.name: Boundary: Delivered Exactly 14 Days Ago
scenarios.description: Delivered exactly 14.0 days ago; eligible at the limit.
customer_messages: Is order ord_elig_01 still eligible for a refund today?
